title: Commercial Phalaenopsis Orchid Production in India: Varieties, Diseases, and Market Economics
excerpt: Commercial Phalaenopsis orchid production in India requires far more than protected structures alone. This article focuses on the operational and business dimensions of Phalaenopsis cultivation, including root-zone management, fertigation, water quality, disease and pest ecology, hybrid selection, regional suitability, and production scheduling. It further examines market grading standards, cost structures, and profitability drivers, providing a practical framework for growers and investors evaluating Phalaenopsis as a premium greenhouse enterprise in India.
